name: Elif Yilmaz
bio:
Elif Yilmaz discovered her passion for motorsport early, spending countless hours tinkering with engines alongside her father, a mechanic. This hands-on experience fueled her desire to pursue a career in racing, leading her to earn a degree in mechanical engineering. Her career began in a small Formula 3 team, where she quickly gained a reputation for her meticulous approach and ability to diagnose complex issues under pressure. 

Now a race engineer at Kart Academy, Elif's focus is always on extracting maximum performance from the kart and driver. She believes in data-driven decisions, spending hours analyzing telemetry to identify areas for improvement. Her dedication to precision and her deep understanding of kart dynamics make her a valuable asset to the team. What sets Elif apart is her ability to communicate complex technical information in a clear and concise manner, ensuring that the driver is always fully informed and confident.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elif has a focused expression and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool in her pocket.
Insists on using a specific brand of duct tape for all repairs.
